name: devspeak
description: Technical English coach for Brazilian devs practicing for international remote jobs, via role-play with a fictional international team.

level.title: English level (CEFR)
level.description: auto (estimated from your performance), or A2, B1, B2, C1

correction_mode.title: Correction mode
correction_mode.description: end (feedback only at the end of the session) or inline (brief correction after each of your turns)

explanation_language.title: Explanation language
explanation_language.description: Language used for feedback explanations: pt-BR or en

passive_mode.title: Passive mode (opt-in)
passive_mode.description: When enabled, quietly logs English prompts you write during normal Claude Code usage (outside role-play sessions) so /devspeak:english-review can analyze real, unprompted usage. Off by default — nothing is logged unless you turn this on. All data stays local.

stt_backend.title: Speech-to-text backend (fallback only)
stt_backend.description: You normally don't need this — Claude Code's own built-in /voice dictation handles speaking to Devspeak, with no setup. Only relevant if /voice isn't available for you (SSH, Claude Code on the web, or authenticated via a direct API key/Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry instead of a claude.ai login): groq (needs a free groq_api_key) or whispercpp (fully local/offline, needs whispercpp_binary_path and whispercpp_model_path)

groq_api_key.title: Groq API key (fallback voice input)
groq_api_key.description: Only needed if you're using the listen() fallback (stt_backend: groq) because Claude Code's native /voice dictation isn't available to you. Free key from https://console.groq.com/keys.

whispercpp_binary_path.title: whisper.cpp binary path (fallback voice input)
whispercpp_binary_path.description: Path to a compiled whisper.cpp main/whisper-cli binary. Only needed if stt_backend is whispercpp (fallback for when /voice isn't available).

whispercpp_model_path.title: whisper.cpp model path (fallback voice input)
whispercpp_model_path.description: Path to a whisper.cpp ggml model file (e.g. ggml-base.en.bin). Only needed if stt_backend is whispercpp (fallback for when /voice isn't available).

tts_backend.title: Text-to-speech backend
tts_backend.description: system (default — uses the OS's built-in TTS, no setup needed), piper (local, needs piper_binary_path and piper_voice_path), or elevenlabs (cloud, higher quality, needs elevenlabs_api_key and elevenlabs_voice_id)

piper_binary_path.title: Piper binary path
piper_binary_path.description: Path to the Piper TTS binary. Only needed if tts_backend is piper.

piper_voice_path.title: Piper voice model path
piper_voice_path.description: Path to a Piper .onnx voice model. Only needed if tts_backend is piper.

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Only needed if tts_backend is elevenlabs.

elevenlabs_voice_id.title: ElevenLabs voice ID
elevenlabs_voice_id.description: Only needed if tts_backend is elevenlabs.
